## Recall · Lecture 5

a) A game asks to use the microphone. Which service of the OS decides?
b) A game saves the progress to storage. Which service of the OS does this?
c) A game gets time on a CPU core. Which service of the OS gives it?

::: {.answer}
a) permissions
b) files
c) processes
:::

## Activity 1 · Four facts · 15 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Windows has four tools: About, Task Manager, File Explorer and Device Manager.
- **Do it:** Write the Windows version and RAM, the process with the most CPU, the free space of C: and the graphics card of the lab computer.
- Your product is four facts, each with its tool.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/pc-tour.png)
:::
::::

## Check 1 · Four facts

Which tool gives each fact?

::: {.reveal}
1. Settings › System › About gives the Windows version and the RAM, for example Windows 11 and 16 GB.
2. Task Manager gives the process with the most CPU, for example the browser.
3. File Explorer gives the free space of C:, for example 180 GB.
4. Device Manager › Display adapters gives the graphics card.
:::

## Check 2 · Two facts and one test

What does the phone do with a game in the background?

::: {.reveal}
1. The phone pauses the game when the player switches to another app.
2. When the RAM is full, the OS may close the game to free memory.
3. So a mobile game must save its state when it goes to the background.
4. On a PC, the same game keeps running in the background.
:::

## Wrap-up

- You can find facts about a PC with the four tools of Windows.
- You can find the OS version and permissions of a phone, and explain what it does with a game in the background.
